en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a dense European town with 19th‑century masonry houses and steep tiled roofs. In the foreground are tightly packed multi‑storey buildings and a few larger public edifices with ornate facades. A river runs across the middle distance with a long metal truss bridge. Beyond the river stretch more residential blocks and factory chimneys, then rolling hills. Several steeples and a hilltop church are visible, along with a tall memorial‑like column in a park area. There is no printed caption or visible writing on the image side.
